reasoning: Vitanex is a life-critical emergency response system. It requires absolute clarity, immediate trust, and visible urgency. Archetype 4 offers high-contrast functionality (Signal Red for alerts, Stark White/Grey for data legibility). Dark mode is reserved only for specific high-focus command center widgets if needed, but the primary theme is light and sterile.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-slate-900

layout.spacing_system: Generous. p-6 or p-8 for dashboard cards to avoid data collision.
layout.marketing_grid: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Wide, asymmetric blocks.
layout.dashboard_grid: MODE B: 'Control Room' Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Dense, screen-filling, functional.
layout.radius: Sharp. Use rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) maximum. No large pill shapes unless it's a status badge.

components.surface: Technical Grid style. Use flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200), and zero shadow for resting states. Add soft shadows on hover.
components.sos_button: Massive scale. bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white rounded-full aspect-square flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(220,38,38,0.4)] animate-pulse hover:animate-none transition-all.
components.cards: border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm. Must have internal padding of p-6.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav with crystal glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200).

motion.interactions: Crisp transitions. hover:-translate-y-1 for cards. Focus rings MUST be highly visible (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2).
motion.animations: Use ping or pulse animations exclusively for active 'Golden Hour' emergencies to draw immediate eye contact on dashboards.

images.description: Paramedics actively treating a patient, conveying the urgency of the Golden Hour
Ambulance parked on the side of road ready for dispatch
High-tech monitoring equipment in a hospital room

testing.attributes: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='sos-trigger-button', data-testid='accept-alert-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the public landing page strictly in custom HTML/Tailwind for maximum layout flexibility (bento grids, overlapping). Do NOT use Shadcn Card wrappers for marketing sections.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively for the 4 internal portals (User, Hospital, NGO, Admin) to ensure data density and functional clarity.
In the User Portal, the SOS button must be the most visually dominant element on the screen (use the 'sos_button' component spec).
In Hospital/NGO portals, ensure absolute tabular clarity using 'IBM Plex Sans' for patient vitals (HR, SpO2). Numeric data must never be ambiguous.
Color code alerts strictly: Red (Critical/Golden Hour), Yellow (Pending Review), Green (Resolved/Dispatched).
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Stick to 'Cabinet Grotesk' for authoritative medical branding.
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use ONLY the exact URLs provided in the assets section.
